name: LEDGE
tagline: The Pons Number, measured hourly with its denominator attached.
signatureElement: The colophon strip — LEDGE.TOOLS set in wide-tracked mono beside the measurement stamp, seated between a 3px mid rule and a 7px heavy rule, closing the fold so that any phone screenshot cropped between the fold's two heavy rules is already a complete, self-attributing citation: figure, denominator, sample size, window, age, source URL and measurement timestamp all inside the crop.
